All fixed and verified. Full workspace builds clean (exit 0), all touched-crate tests pass (799), clippy clean, rustfmt clean.

## What changed

**#1 Cron weekday `7` never fired** — `jfc-daemon/src/cron.rs`
Added `CronField::parse_weekday` which accepts `0..=7` and normalizes `7 → 0` (both are Sunday in POSIX) so it matches chrono's `0..=6`. `0 0 * * 7` now fires on Sundays.

**#2 Out-of-range cron fields silently never fired** — `cron.rs`
`CronField::parse` now takes `min..=max` per field (minute 0–59, hour 0–23, day 1–31, month 1–12, weekday 0–7) and rejects out-of-range literals at parse time instead of accepting `Exact(99)`/`Exact(32)` that can never match.

**#3 Dreamer lease TOCTOU race** — `jfc-knowledge/src/lib.rs` + `jfc-learn/src/dreamer.rs`
Added `KnowledgeStore::try_acquire_lease_artifact`, a single-statement conditional upsert (`ON CONFLICT … DO UPDATE … WHERE json_extract(expiry_ms) <= now`) that is atomic under SQLite's write lock. `acquire_lease` now uses it instead of the racy `get`→check→`upsert`, so two concurrent dreamers can never both "hold" the lease (the read-back remains only to build the diagnostic message).

**#4 `parse_duration_spec` integer overflow** — `cron.rs`
`n * 60/3600/86_400` and the running `total` now use `saturating_mul`/`saturating_add`, so an absurd `@every …d` no longer panics (debug) or wraps to a bogus period (release).

**#5 Cron day-of-month/day-of-week now POSIX** — `cron.rs`
New `day_and_weekday_match`: when both fields are restricted it fires on EITHER (Vixie semantics, e.g. `0 0 13 * 5` = "13th OR any Friday"); a `*` field drops out and the rest AND normally. Doc comment updated.

**#6 `hamming_distance` misnomer** — `jfc-core/src/semantic_hash.rs`
Renamed to `magnitude_distance` with a doc note that it's the deterministic arithmetic model (NOT bit-Hamming), pointing at the real bit-Hamming in `adaptive_sizer`. Behavior of the proof-mirror model is unchanged.

**#7 `Retry-After` HTTP-date ignored** — `jfc-anthropic-sdk/src/retry.rs`
`parse_retry_after` now falls back to parsing the IMF-fixdate form (e.g. `Wed, 21 Oct 2015 07:28:00 GMT`) via a testable `http_date_to_delay(s, now)` helper (past → `ZERO`, unparseable → `None`).

## Tests added
- `cron.rs`: weekday-7 normalization, range rejection, duration saturation, and the AND/OR day-weekday matrix.
- `jfc-knowledge`: atomic lease acquire/expiry/takeover (also proves `json_extract` is available in this SQLite build).
- `retry.rs`: HTTP-date future/past/garbage + `parse_retry_after` accepts a date.

One note on #7: chrono validates the weekday against the date, so a malformed `Retry-After` date (wrong day name) falls through to computed backoff rather than being trusted — the safe behavior.
